## Role in the Rating Process

The Eurogroup consists of finance ministers from the euro area. It coordinates fiscal policy across member states. The Eurogroup shapes decisions on backstop and program eligibility (R6-A*). This is because the Eurogroup ministers also govern the [European Stability Mechanism](../institutions/european-stability-mechanism.qmd), which provides financial assistance.
